image_title: Department of Defense Rate Reduction and Improvement
summary: The table titled 'Department of Defense Rate Reduction and Improvement' presents data comparing fiscal years 2002 (FY 02) and 2009 (FY 09) across various branches of the Department of Defense (DOD). In FY 02, the All DOD rate was 31.5, which reduced to 18.7 in FY 09, reflecting a rate reduction of 12.8 and a percent improvement of 41%. The Army's rate decreased from 29.3 in FY 02 to 17.8 in FY 09, with a reduction of 11.5 and an improvement of 39%. The Navy saw a decline from 39.8 to 21.2, resulting in an 18.6 reduction and a 46% improvement. The Marines had a significant drop from 73.8 to 36.7, with a rate reduction of 37.1 and a 50% improvement. The Air Force's rate fell from 25.6 to 16.5, showing a reduction of 9.1 and a 36% improvement. Lastly, Defense Logistics decreased from 25.6 to 16.9, with an 8.7 reduction and a 34% improvement.
